title: Loan Purpose Adjustment, Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit
content:
**Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit — purpose adjustment**

A purpose adjustment applies to the Hometown Heroes award, read from the loan purpose and the first-time homebuyer marking on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File. It is added to the starting amount with its sign, before the award is raised to 500.00 when below it and lowered to the program's credit cap when above it.

| Loan file | Purpose adjustment |
|---|---|
| rate-and-term refinance | subtracts 150.00 |
| purchase by a first-time homebuyer | adds 100.00 |
| any other file | adds nothing |

**Clause.** A rate-and-term refinance subtracts 150.00, a purchase by a first-time homebuyer adds 100.00, and any other file adds nothing.

### Cases (hypothetical files)

- Purchase, file marked first-time homebuyer: adds 100.00.
- Purchase, not a first-time homebuyer: adds nothing.
- Rate-and-term refinance: subtracts 150.00.
